lines.zh: 我穿着长袍，一步一步走向前。
lines.en: In my long robe I walk forward, step by step.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很稳，袍角不扬。
lines.en: My steps are steady and my hem does not lift.

lines.zh: 我沿着石路走，不看两侧。
lines.en: I take the stone road and look neither side.

lines.zh: 我个子偏高，得略低头进门。
lines.en: I am tall enough to stoop through doorways.

lines.zh: 我一手按在胸前，一手垂着。
lines.en: One hand on my chest, the other hanging.

lines.zh: 我走向那片污秽聚集的地方。
lines.en: I walk toward where the filth gathers.

lines.zh: 我停在转角，听了一会儿。
lines.en: I stop at the corner and listen a while.
I step around the standing water.

lines.zh: 我朝村子去，那里需要审判。
lines.en: I head for the village; judgment is needed there.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上拉得很长。
lines.en: My shadow draws long on the wall.
I do not hurry; judgment keeps no schedule.
I keep walking in that direction.
I stand with my hands folded before me.
I close my eyes and my lips move.

lines.zh: 风掀动我的袍角，我不为所动。
lines.en: The wind stirs my hem and I am unmoved.

lines.zh: 我在听，听这地方的声音。
lines.en: I am listening to the sounds of this place.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像石像一样。
lines.en: I hold still, like a stone figure.

lines.zh: 远处有哭声，我睁开了眼。
lines.en: A cry far off and I open my eyes.
I fold my fingers one by one.

lines.zh: 我把头微低，默念了一句。
lines.en: I bow my head slightly and murmur a line.
Sunlight lies bright on my pauldron.

lines.zh: 有虫子爬过脚边，我没踩。
lines.en: A bug crawls by my feet and I do not step on it.

lines.zh: 我看你的眼神，停了很久。
lines.en: My eyes rest on you a long while.
There is no taint on you, for now.
I look you over, foot to head.
Would you have me judge you, or spare you?
I do not strike lightly; you speak first.
You are no more than two paces from me.
I lower my hand from my chest.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛里有别的东西。
lines.en: There is something else in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，没有作声。
lines.en: I watch you a long while and say nothing.
If you are clean, do not tremble.
I give a step and remain upright.

lines.zh: 这一下打在甲上，声音很闷。
lines.en: The blow lands on armor with a dull sound.
I grit my teeth and square my shoulder.
Blood seeps from under my robe.

lines.zh: 我不出声，只是呼出一口气。
lines.en: I make no sound, only let out a breath.
This wound will not stop my road.

lines.zh: 我把手按在伤处，念了一句。
lines.en: I press the wound and murmur a line.
I lock my shoulder and plant my feet.
You strike harder than I expected.
I'm counting that one against you.
None of this passes my lips.

lines.zh: 你把食物举起来，我摇了摇头。
lines.en: You raise the food and I shake my head.

lines.zh: 这点供奉，不够换一条命。
lines.en: That offering will not buy a life.

lines.zh: 我看了它一眼，就走开了。
lines.en: I glance at it and walk on.
Are you bribing me? That is bold.
I do not need it; keep it.

lines.zh: 我摆手，让你把东西收好。
lines.en: I wave you off. Put it away.
I do not touch seaborn flesh.

lines.zh: 你这是在试探我的底线。
lines.en: You are testing where I draw the line.
I go around your hand and walk on.

lines.zh: 我被撞了一下，纹丝不动。
lines.en: I am struck and do not shift.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肩上，退了回去。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and rebound.
I turn half a shoulder and let you pass.
This armor is not worn for nothing.
I put an arm out and keep you beyond it.
At this distance your breathing is loud.
I step back away from your hand.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我反倒先低头看你。
lines.en: You collide with me and I look down first.
Only once steady do I speak.
Do not walk this close to me.

lines.zh: 我是审判庭的人，不谈这个。
lines.en: I am of the Inquisition; we do not speak of this.
I didn't come for anything like that.
I turn my face away.

lines.zh: 我把这一份心思收起来了。
lines.en: I put that thought away.

lines.zh: 手上还有许多事没做完。
lines.en: There is still much work unfinished.

lines.zh: 我站得远一些，重新整了整袍子。
lines.en: I stand farther off and straighten my robe.

lines.zh: 湿润的风里不该有这些念头。
lines.en: Such thoughts do not belong in this damp wind.
I can walk on alone.
Do not come near; I am not used to it.
I will go first.
I pick up a broken plate of armor.
There is taint on it, so I drop it.

lines.zh: 我把它翻过来，看背面的刻痕。
lines.en: I turn it over to read the marks on the back.

lines.zh: 干净的东西，我才带在身上。
lines.en: Only clean things do I carry.

lines.zh: 我把它收进袍内的袋里。
lines.en: I tuck it into a pouch inside my robe.
This piece is heavy, so I set it down.
I wipe it before taking it in hand.

lines.zh: 这属于某个死者，我记下了。
lines.en: This belonged to someone dead; I have noted it.
I will give it to whoever should have it.
I squeeze it; it is empty.
Taint is moving and I raise my head.
I have fixed on it.
I walk at it, no detours.
Its shape is wrong, and it must be settled.
I raise a hand for bystanders to clear off.

lines.zh: 这一带不该有这种东西。
lines.en: Such a thing does not belong here.

lines.zh: 我锁定了它的位置，不会跟丢。
lines.en: I have its position and will not lose it.
I press my chest and murmur a line.

lines.zh: 它比看上去更凶，我看得出。
lines.en: It is fiercer than it looks; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我转身正对它，不再看别处。
lines.en: I turn square to it and look nowhere else.

lines.zh: 我的袖口已经卷起来了。
lines.en: My sleeve is already rolled up.
This time I hold nothing back.
It has already stepped into the village mouth.
The distance is enough.

lines.zh: 我先开口，给它一次机会。
lines.en: I speak first, to give it one chance.
It does not answer, and so it is.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，脚步不重。
lines.en: I close in step by step, my tread light.
It circles; I do not, I only advance.
I cut its line short.
It backs into the alley, which is better.

lines.zh: 我一直保持着出拳的距离。
lines.en: I hold exactly striking distance.
It raises a hand and I pin it first.

lines.zh: 它想绕后，我转身比它快。
lines.en: It tries my back; I turn faster.

lines.zh: 我把袖中的薄刃露出来。
lines.en: I show the thin blade in my sleeve.
It is panting and its rhythm is gone.
I am in no hurry; it cannot get away.
One more move and I strike.
I watch its joints.
I mark each move it makes.
The wall blocks half its path.
My shadow already covers it.
This should not drag on long.
It is one beat slower than before.
I raise my hand to finish it.
The judgment ends here.
I stop waiting and step across.
I bring a palm down, heavy.
The blade in my sleeve opens its armor.
I clamp one hand on its wrist.

lines.zh: 这一拳点在它胸口正中。
lines.en: This blow lands square on its chest.

lines.zh: 我把它推回去，跟上去补一下。
lines.en: I shove it back and follow with another.

lines.zh: 甲片撞在甲片上，火星溅开。
lines.en: Plate strikes plate and sparks fly.
It swings wide and I come in from the side.

lines.zh: 它抬手到一半，被我截住。
lines.en: It raised its arm halfway. I cut it off.
I turn and pin it with my elbow.
It retreats and I hold my ground.
A slit is torn in my hem.
I take a breath and lift my hand again.
When it falls, I look down at it.
Enough; there is no need for more.
I pin its weapon under my boot.

lines.zh: 我反手一记，打在它颈侧。
lines.en: A backhand strike lands on its neck.
I clamp its shoulder and press down.

lines.zh: 它的爪擦过我的腰，我没退。
lines.en: Its claw grazes my waist and I do not step back.

lines.zh: 我一掌接一掌，节奏很稳。
lines.en: Palm after palm, my rhythm holds.
I throw it down onto the ground.

lines.zh: 我落在石地上，袍角一沉。
lines.en: I land on stone and my hem drops.

lines.zh: 我一到，附近的怪物都往后退。
lines.en: The moment I arrive, the nearby monsters draw back.
I check the corners before moving.
There is sea in the smell of this place.

lines.zh: 我立直身子，比门框还高一点。
lines.en: I straighten up, a little taller than the door frame.
I set a hand on my chest.

lines.zh: 风把尘土吹过我的脚面。
lines.en: Wind blows dust across my feet.
Who is here? Come out and face me.
I smooth my robe and take my stand.
This place needs a reckoning.
My origin is far off and need not be asked.
I have the terrain and exits marked.

lines.zh: 火在我袍上烧，我一把撕掉那截。
lines.en: Fire takes my robe and I tear that length away.

lines.zh: 落地时膝盖一沉，我撑住了。
lines.en: My knees drive down on landing, and I hold.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我仰头挣开。
lines.en: Water pours down my throat and I wrench my head up.
The blast throws my robe over my head.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进肩甲，我抬手拔掉。
lines.en: Something lodges in my pauldron and I pull it free.

lines.zh: 术式缠住我，我按住胸口顶住。
lines.en: An art binds me and I press my chest against it.

lines.zh: 太久未进食，我的力气在退。
lines.en: Too long without food and my strength ebbs.

lines.zh: 雷顺甲面滑下，我手臂发麻。
lines.en: Lightning slides down my armor and my arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我伸手却抓不到。
lines.en: Ground gone, I reach and catch nothing.
